item.title: Iran War: India to procure five more Russian S-400s after Op Sindoor success
item.description: The move aims to strengthen India’s layered air defence network along both eastern and western fronts and address evolving aerial threats in the region.

item.title: ‘Trump has no plan in Iran; war based on lies’: US Senator Elizabeth Warren after classified briefing
item.description: Iran War: US Senator Elizabeth Warren's message comes amid varied and shifting narratives from Trump and his cabinet on why they launched the attack on Iran.

item.title: Petronet LNG shares plunge 12%; GAIL, GSPL, MGL, Gujarat Gas drop up to 6%; here's why
item.description: Petronet LNG plunged 11.69 per cent to Rs 273. The company has an existing LNG contract of 7.5 mmtpa with QatarEnergy. GAIL fell 6.08 per cent to Rs 155.05 and has an LNG supply contract of 1 mmtpa with the supplier.

item.title: IndiGo, SpiceJet shares fall up to 8% amid West Asia tensions, flight disruption
item.description: The airline said that “in view of the evolving airspace restrictions over Iran and the Middle East, more than 500 flights to the Middle East and select international destinations have been cancelled".

item.title: Why is market down today: Top reasons behind Sensex, Nifty crash
item.description: Market cap of BSE-listed firms fell by Rs 9.13 lakh crore to Rs 447.42 lakh crore today against the market cap of Rs 456.55 lakh crore on March 2.

item.title: Sensex, Nifty crash: India VIX surges 24% as bears tighten grip on D-Street
item.description: India VIX rises: The global fears spilled onto the Indian equity indices with India VIX, the volatility index, of the Indian stock market surging 23.87% to 21.22 against 17.13 on Monday.

item.title: Iran strikes US military communication infra in Bahrain, Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, UAE: Report
item.description: US-Israel-Iran war: It appeared that Iran was targeting to disrupt the US military's ability to communicate and coordinate.

item.title: Gold futures rise above Rs 1.63 lakh, silver volatile as West Asia tensions drive safe-haven buying
item.description: Gold and silver prices witnessed sharp volatility on Wednesday as escalating tensions in West Asia pushed investors toward safe-haven assets. However, international prices pulled back from recent highs as a stronger US dollar and uncertainty around Federal Reserve rate cuts triggered profit-booking in global markets.

item.title: Will India return to Russian oil amid Strait of Hormuz disruptions?
item.description: Oil prices: Analysts noted that at least three crude tankers have been damaged, and Maersk, one of the largest shipping firms, has suspended all cargo via the Strait of Hormuz.
